body: The owner asked to build every P3/P4 feature; ADR-0007 already set how vendor services are built (own module each, plain REST where the SDK is heavy, in-process fakes). The coordinator picked the vendors the spec names; Uploadcare and Instagram are skipped, and Supabase is documented as S3-compatible. Revisit when an app needs another provider.
title: HOSTED vendors: Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Vercel Blob, Cloudinary
